status: candidate formal overlay pending independent review/CI/owner merge; NOT published or frozen, and no implementation or runner exists in this contract PR
description: Negative contract vectors for the rev-7 additive Linux read-only traffic observation. They are normative expectations for the rev-7 implementation PR; JSON parsing alone is not conformance and no runner is claimed here. Each vector names its rejection stage: json_schema (the rev-7 JSON Schema or strict size/parse stage rejects before semantic checks), implementation_semantic (schema-valid but rejected by the normative coherence/privacy/lexical rules in docs/um/um-a/04-node-protocol-v1.rev7.md), platform_isolation (rejected because of the authenticated node class), or config_generation (a center must never emit the config, and an agent must fail closed if it receives it). Base bodies are examples/report-snapshot.rev7.json and examples/agent-config.rev7.json; patch paths are RFC 6901 JSON Pointers.

vectors.mutation: exactness claims exact instead of lower_bound (exact/lower-bound ambiguity is forbidden)

expected.reason: exactness is const lower_bound; a lower bound must never be represented as an exact total

vectors.mutation: per-inbound lower-bound bytes are a fractional number (1234.5)

expected.reason: byte counters are integers; fractional observed bytes are rejected

vectors.mutation: byte counter is lexically a JSON float (1048576.0) even though its mathematical value is integral

expected.reason: JSON Schema treats 1048576.0 as an integer, so the center MUST additionally enforce canonical integer lexical form for byte/sequence/time fields (no '.', 'e' or 'E' token)

vectors.mutation: per-inbound lower-bound bytes are negative

expected.reason: observed counters are unsigned and cannot decrease below zero in one observation epoch

vectors.mutation: byte counter exceeds the 2^53-1 safe-integer bound

expected.reason: rev-7 byte counters are bounded to 9007199254740991 so every JSON consumer (including a JavaScript/front-end) sees the exact value; overflow must never wrap or be rounded by the implementation

vectors.mutation: source_epoch is uppercase hex instead of 32 lowercase hex characters

expected.reason: source_epoch grammar is exactly ^[0-9a-f]{32}$ and is independent of the base counter_epoch

vectors.mutation: observation sequence is negative

expected.reason: sequence is a non-negative safe integer that increases inside one source_epoch and never authorizes anything

vectors.mutation: contract_revision is 6 (a rev-6 body cannot carry the rev-7 observation object)

expected.reason: rev-7 bodies are discriminated by the required const contract_revision=7; rev-5 bodies have no contract_revision at all

vectors.mutation: freshness token is not in the closed enum (current)

expected.reason: freshness is exactly fresh|stale|unavailable; unknown tokens are rejected, never rendered

vectors.mutation: per-inbound quality token is not in the closed enum (exact)

expected.reason: quality is exactly lower_bound|partial|unavailable; no observation from the monitor export is exact

vectors.mutation: unknown field inside traffic_observation (exact_total_bytes)

expected.reason: traffic_observation and every nested object are closed (additionalProperties=false); no side channel may smuggle a total or arbitrary text

vectors.mutation: inbounds array exceeds the maximum of 8 entries

expected.reason: inbounds is capped at 8, matching expected_inbound_tags maxItems 8; larger arrays are rejected before storage

vectors.mutation: required freshness field removed

expected.reason: all twelve traffic_observation fields are required, including freshness and availability; there is no implicit default

vectors.mutation: per-inbound observed rate is negative

expected.reason: observed rates are non-negative numbers bounded to 10^12 bps

vectors.mutation: source is monitor_export instead of the frozen monitor_readonly_export token

expected.reason: the report source token is const monitor_readonly_export; monitor_export is the agent-config switch name, not the observation source

vectors.mutation: age_seconds is fractional

expected.reason: age_seconds is an integer in [0,86400] computed by the agent as collected_at - observed_at

vectors.mutation: observed_at exceeds the contract timestamp bound

expected.reason: every rev-5/rev-7 timestamp is bounded to 10^12 epoch seconds

vectors.mutation: freshness is stale while top-level availability is ok (stale observation presented as fully available)

expected.reason: availability=ok requires freshness=fresh; a stale observation can only be partial or unavailable

vectors.mutation: freshness is stale although age_seconds is inside the fresh bound

expected.reason: freshness is derived from age_seconds and the applied cadence: fresh iff age <= max(2*cadence,120)s (capped at 600s); a label contradicting its own age is rejected

vectors.mutation: inbound tag is not one of the center-configured expected_inbound_tags (rogue-in)

expected.reason: the agent must only report tags from its applied expected_inbound_tags allowlist; the center independently rejects a body containing an unauthorized tag or kind rather than storing it

vectors.mutation: kind is a valid enum value but contradicts the configured kind for vless-in (marked hysteria2)

expected.reason: tag and kind must match the applied expected_inbound_tags exactly; attribution is never guessed or rewritten

vectors.mutation: two inbounds entries carry the same inbound_tag

expected.reason: duplicate inbound tags cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and MUST be rejected by the implementation; per-tag counters are never summed twice

vectors.mutation: observed rates are present while rate_window_seconds is null

expected.reason: a rate without a declared window is uninterpretable; null window requires null rates (and vice versa when the observation is available)

vectors.mutation: base traffic array is non-empty and availability.traffic is ok, presenting observed lower bounds as total bytes

expected.reason: for a rev-7 Linux body the base traffic array MUST stay [] and availability.traffic MUST NOT be ok; observed lower bounds live only in traffic_observation and are never relabelled as totals

vectors.mutation: per-inbound quality is lower_bound while both byte counters are null

expected.reason: quality=lower_bound requires both integer lower-bound counters; missing data is quality=unavailable/null, never a fabricated zero or a lower_bound label with no value

vectors.mutation: observed_at is in the future relative to collected_at (collected_at + 120s) while age_seconds claims 0

expected.reason: age_seconds must equal collected_at - observed_at, and observed_at must not exceed collected_at + 60s; a future observation is rejected as untrusted clock data

vectors.mutation: single-inbound active connection counts do not add up to the top-level active_connections when observation availability is ok

expected.reason: when availability=ok, top-level active_connections equals the sum of per-inbound counts; an incoherent count is rejected, never silently corrected

vectors.mutation: a windows_terminal node submits this rev-7 body unchanged (contract_revision/traffic_observation present)

expected.reason: rev-7 observation is Linux-only; node_class is bound by the enrollment token and the center rejects the payload before storage

vectors.mutation: a linux_vps rev-7 body also carries the Windows terminal object

expected.reason: the base rev-5 platform isolation remains in force: a linux_vps node MUST NOT send terminal, with or without rev-7 observation

vectors.mutation: no-observation sentinel is incomplete (all-zero epoch but nonzero sequence/observed_at)

expected.reason: the documented no-observation sentinel requires sequence=0 and observed_at=0 as well; a zero epoch is only legal in the exact sentinel form and is never treated as an observation

vectors.mutation: collect.monitor_export=true on a windows_terminal config

expected.reason: the rev-7 source is linux_vps-only; a Windows node can never receive it and a Windows agent rejects a config that enables a class-forbidden source (platform_mismatch) while keeping its previous config

vectors.mutation: collect.monitor_export is the string "true" instead of a JSON boolean

expected.reason: the switch is a boolean; a string or numeric truthy value is rejected rather than coerced

vectors.mutation: collect contains an unknown source key besides monitor_export (traffic_probe=true)

expected.reason: collect stays closed to the six frozen rev-5 switches plus the single optional monitor_export; no new source can appear by config
